crossRefs.note: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.
Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man:
When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the…
They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.
Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of…
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…

translations.web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
translations.bsb: The plans of the righteous are just, but the counsel of the wicked leads to deceit.
translations.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
translations.asv: The thoughts of the righteous are just; But the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
